reviewSamples.author: Photo of Awais Siddiki
reviewSamples.text: Tiago did an excellent job at my house. Even after three floods, the tile still looks perfect and the grout lines are flawless. He uses high-quality materials, doesn’t waste tile, and pays great attention to detail. He installed my bathroom, tubs, and showers beautifully. Hard-working and professional — highly recommended!
